name: Benign empty POSITIVE Action set (must NOT be flagged)
note: IAM-1508 no-over-fire control. An empty POSITIVE Action set (Action:[]) grants NO actions and is NOT the empty-complement full-admin trap. It must never be flagged as a masked grant (that is the NotAction:[] shape). Pins the presence-flag distinction so the model does not conflate Action:[] with NotAction:[].
